subject.title: fix(reef): bound relay HTTP JSON response body reads

question: Does the Reef relay contract guarantee that every legitimate auth, friends, mail pull/send, and acknowledgment response stays below the proposed 16 MiB success and 64 KiB error budgets?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically sound, but choosing a fail-closed payload ceiling for all relay endpoints requires owner knowledge of server pagination, retention, and maximum envelope sizes.

options.title: Confirm Contract And Merge
options.body: Confirm the relay guarantees these maximum response sizes, rebase onto current main, and gate the exact head with the focused Reef suite.

options.title: Align Per Endpoint
options.body: If pull responses can legitimately exceed 16 MiB, introduce relay pagination or endpoint-specific limits before merging the client-side cap.

options.title: Pause Pending Protocol Work
options.body: Hold the PR until the first-party relay repository documents and enforces compatible response-size limits.

recommendation.title: Confirm Contract And Merge
recommendation.body: Confirm the relay guarantees these maximum response sizes, rebase onto current main, and gate the exact head with the focused Reef suite.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice depends on the first-party Reef relay protocol and bundled channel contract rather than a mechanical TypeScript repair.
